home.title: Home
home.description: Your location, speed, accident risk, and weather will appear here.

map.title: Map
map.unavailable: The map needs a development build. It is not available in Expo Go or on web.

profile.title: Profile
profile.description: Your details, emergency contacts, and driving stats will appear here.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Alert, voice, unit, and privacy preferences will appear here.
settings.restartHint: Switching to or from Arabic restarts the app.

safety.reportDescription: The accident report form will appear here.

errors.watch: Could not read your location. Check location services and try again.
errors.permission: Could not check location access. Try again.

permission.servicesOffBody: Turn on location services for your device so OSY can follow your position and speed.
permission.requestBody: OSY uses your location and speed while the app is open to warn you about road risks. Motion access helps it notice a crash.
permission.deniedBody: OSY cannot show your position or speed without location access.
permission.limitedBody: OSY is using your approximate location, so speed and road details may be wrong.
permission.motionRequestBody: Motion access helps OSY notice a crash. Location still works without it.
permission.motionDeniedBody: Location still works, but OSY will not be able to use motion to notice a crash.

background.title: Keep crash detection on
background.body: OSY needs your location all the time to notice a crash while your phone is locked or another app is open. It runs at full power only while you drive, and your location is not recorded.

crash_detected.title: Possible crash detected
crash_detected.body: Are you OK? Open OSY to respond.

potential_accident.title: Accident risk ahead
potential_accident.body: Slow down and take extra care.

accident_nearby.title: Accident nearby
accident_nearby.body: Someone may need help. Open OSY for details.

permission.requestBody: OSY uses notifications to warn you about road risks and reach you after a crash.
permission.deniedBody: OSY cannot warn you when the app is closed unless notifications are on.

dev.title: Test alerts
dev.lockedCrash: Simulate a crash in 15 s (lock the phone now)

checkIn.title: Are you OK?
checkIn.stillWaiting: We haven’t heard from you yet.
checkIn.sharedTitle: If you need help, OSY will share:
checkIn.escalatedTitle: We could not confirm you’re OK

auth.registerDescription: Your details help OSY reach the right people in an emergency.
auth.offline: You are offline. This step needs a connection.

errors.invalidCredentials: The email or password is wrong.

auth.mobileHint: Include your country code, such as +213.

documents.title: Your documents
documents.description: OSY needs your driver’s licence and car registration before you can use the app.
documents.loadFailed: Your documents could not be loaded. Check your connection and try again.
documents.consentBody: OSY uses your documents to confirm your identity and your vehicle. Text is read on your phone, then the images and the details you confirm are sent securely to OSY.
documents.consentAccept: I agree to OSY using my documents this way
documents.sideFront: Add the front of the document.
documents.sideBack: Add the back of the document.
documents.cameraDenied: OSY cannot use the camera. You can still choose a photo or a file.
documents.reviewDescription: Check each detail and correct anything that is wrong.

errors.fileType: Use a JPG, PNG, or PDF file.
errors.fileSize: The file must be 10 MB or smaller.
errors.captureFailed: That did not work. Try again, or use another option.

documents.scanHint: Take a photo of the document now

documents.checkField: Check this one. It may not have been read correctly.
documents.nameMismatch: The name on this licence does not match your account.

weather.unconfigured: Weather will be available when the weather service is connected.
weather.offline: No saved weather is available for this area. Reconnect to update.
weather.locationRequired: Allow location access and wait for a recent position to load local weather.
weather.unavailable: Weather is unavailable. Try refreshing shortly.
weather.previousArea: Weather for the last saved area; your current area is not confirmed.
weather.stale: These conditions are out of date and are excluded from current risk estimates.
weather.icingEstimate: Weather-based estimate; road surface conditions are not measured.
weather.refreshFailed: Could not refresh weather. The last saved values remain visible.

status.noLocation: OSY does not know your location. Call emergency services.
status.canceled: Your request for help was canceled.
